name: spectral_smear_granular
title: Spectral smear into granular half-speed and a loop
material: any mono source; textured or noisy material responds especially well
description: The canonical starter chain: time-average the spectrum with blur blur (softening attacks and fusing texture), pull the result through modify brassage at half velocity (granular time-stretch that keeps pitch), then cut a rhythmic cell from it with extend loop. Auto-PVOC handles both domain crossings — you feed a .wav and get a .wav back.
source: Verified end-to-end against real CDP since Phase 1a as the acceptance chain (tests/test_acceptance.py).
notes: blurring is the number of analysis windows averaged - 10 is a gentle smear; 40+ dissolves attacks entirely.
brassage velocity < 1 lengthens (0.5 doubles the duration); grain placement is unseeded-stochastic, so renders differ at byte level run to run.
extend loop len is in MILLISECONDS (300 = 0.3 s cell); output duration is cnt * len / 1000.
